finalText:
**Found it.** The pricing engine was rounding after each discount in USD, then converting and rounding again. This double-rounding lost precision before the currency conversion, especially noticeable in non-USD currencies where rates don't divide evenly.

The fix: removed intermediate rounding. Now it applies both discounts without rounding, converts to the target currency, and rounds only once at the end—just like the reference implementation does. All 40 tests pass.
